encoder: two shared fully connected hidden layers; separate linear action and scalar value heads
observation_normalization: none beyond explicit edge endpoint /53 and turn /1000 features

ppo.advantage_normalization: whole rollout; population standard deviation plus 1e-8

ddqn.target_updates: hard copy every 1000 optimizer updates, after online update
ddqn.exploration: uniform among legal actions; linear epsilon by learner transition count
ddqn.bootstrap: masked online argmax evaluated by target network; bootstrap through administrative truncations
ddqn.unused_head: the shared architecture includes a scalar value head unused by DDQN (257 parameters at width 256)

evaluation_policy: deterministic masked argmax for both algorithms
validation_selection: maximum mean terminal reward across validation rows, ties prefer earlier transition checkpoint
reproducibility_scope: pinned libraries, game and policy RNG states and seeds; no cross-hardware bitwise determinism guarantee; PYTHONHASHSEED was not explicitly set for the executed runs
